# Dialog

Modal for decisions and short forms, on the native element: the browser handles focus trap, Esc and stacking.

`KenosUI.Dialog` · Overlays

## Use

```jsx
<KenosUI.Dialog open onOpenChange={…}>…</KenosUI.Dialog>
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="KenosUI.Dialog" open="{{yes}}" on-open-change="{{…}}">…</x-import>
```

## Notes

Modal on native <dialog>: focus trap, Esc and top layer from the browser.

| prop | type | note |

| `open` * | `boolean` |  |
| `onOpenChange` * | `(open: boolean) => void` |  |
| `title` | `React.ReactNode` |  |
| `description` | `React.ReactNode` |  |
| `footer` | `React.ReactNode` |  |
| `size` | `"xs" \| "sm" \| "md" \| "lg" \| "xl"` | 24 / 28 / 32 / 42 / 56rem. Default "md". |
| `placement` | `"top" \| "center"` |  |
| `closeOnBackdrop` | `boolean` | Default true. |
| `hideClose` | `boolean` |  |

| `children` | `React.ReactNode` |  |
